text:
Danila Yurov is the name in the trade talk. Over the past week Bolavip reported the Wild included him in an offer for Detroit's Dylan Larkin and that the Red Wings wanted more, while Hockey Wilderness ran both "sell high" and "take him off the table" pieces on the same day. Nine goals in 24 games will do that.

The selling-high camp has a point. He's shooting 24% after 15% last season, about three goals ahead of his chances, and our numbers flag him as due to cool. But the chances are real: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 89th percentile for scoring chances from the slot last season, and 62% of his exits leave the zone with possession. His ice time is up two minutes a night over the last ten games.

The open question is offense beyond his own shot. He has just 2 assists, and Evolving-Hockey had his team's chance creation in the bottom 8% with him on last season; his value was defensive. Michael Russo of The Athletic noted Yurov missed practice on Nov. 16 after getting dinged up in Boston. Watch his health and the phones.
